summary: Enhance your project management skills with our Data Analytics training course. Learn to leverage data for better decision-making and project success.
lede: Project management analytics uses project data to assess performance, forecast outcomes, and support delivery decisions. For project managers, PMO analysts, project controls specialists, and delivery leads, it offers practical ways to turn project records into evidence for monitoring and control. You’ll practise cleaning datasets, calculating earned value measures, analysing schedules and cost trends, prioritizing risks, and building Power BI dashboard views and evidence-based status reports; predictive modelling is introduced at a foundational level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, analyse, govern, or report project performance and need practical project management analytics skills without requiring programming expertise.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project delivery terminology, including scope, schedule, cost, milestones, risks, and change control, is recommended. No programming or prior Power BI experience is required. You should be comfortable using spreadsheets and basic formulas. Advanced analytics topics such as Monte Carlo simulation and AI-assisted reporting are taught at conceptual and operational application level, not production engineering level. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended. Power BI access is useful for dashboard exercises, but equivalent spreadsheet templates can support the core learning activities.
